definition.proves: the rule predicate holds at a measured, executed occurrence of the rule's anchor, and fails at another measured, executed occurrence in another J entry
does_not_prove: that the rule's effect/output is the intended one
anything about rules with no occurrence (the empty_cov set)
semantic interaction correctness of a composition
definition.composition: rules measured true in the same J entry / same region-reduction run; ['<singleton>'] (labelled) when no co-occurrence was measured
definition.negative_witness: another J entry whose run reaches the same anchor site and whose predicate is strictly false there
definition.predicate_scope: 'guard' when the rule's pattern is a membership guard (the predicate is the whole guard, one scope per construct since 1.1.0); 'member' when the pattern is a single equality
definition.member_projection: diagnostic only: the single-member projection of a guard, measured at true-guard occurrences; it never decides predicate truth, and under b1 counting the rule-level symbol_observed it feeds additionally gates proved (adjudication 2)

options.note: counting defaults to b1 (G4_REVIEW_PACKET adjudication 2, conservative: proved requires symbol_observed=True; --counting b2 reproduces the 1.1.0 readings exactly); both measurement options default to off; with them off the measurement is the v1 domain (region pipeline only, strict 4.1 negative witness only)
